label: Nereid gets its author
from: Subject 00-400, Leviathan — modified by Dr. Hathaway to be consent-based
to: CREATED by Dr. Marianne Hathaway, out of Leviathan, FOR Cassandra
note: TIMELESS — no arc, in force at every lens position, because Nereid facts do not sit at a point in the story. Marianne Hathaway is the Dr. Hathaway the Archive already carried in three places without ever joining them up: the one who made Leviathan's pathogen consent-based, the one Abbi transitioned with, and — it turns out — the author of the whole thing. She built it for Cassandra, who became the first affirmed woman and then her wife. The Archive had the creator filed as a modifier of her own work.
